subject: Materials Science
title: Lattice Parameters and Symmetry
description: One-minute skill: Lattice Parameters and Symmetry.

hook.text: A cube has three equal edges at right angles. But most crystals aren't that simple.

buildup.text: Lattice parameters describe the unit cell: three edge lengths (a, b, c) and three angles (α, β, γ).

discovery.text: These six numbers — plus atom positions — define every crystal in the universe.

twist.text: Symmetry operations — rotations, mirrors, inversions — reduce infinite arrangements to just 230 space groups.

climax.text: X-ray diffraction reveals lattice parameters to picometer precision — measuring atomic architecture.

punchline.text: Six numbers and a set of symmetries describe any crystal on Earth.

quiz.question: How many lattice parameters define a unit cell?
